J-1.given: Settings is open and the theme is Light
J-1.when: the person picks Dark in the Appearance control
J-1.then: the whole app turns dark at once, with no reload, and Dark shows as selected
continues: the other Settings rows keep their values and layout

check.evidence: screenshots of Settings before and after, desktop and phone, light and dark

J-2.then: the page paints dark from the first frame and Settings still shows Dark

check.evidence: screenshot of the first painted frame after reload, plus Settings after reload

S-1.expect: the theme store and boot script tests pass, including the storage-blocked case

steps.reason: every page reads the stored theme key and the data-theme attribute, so their shape must be right before the UI builds on them
